authority: All 25 frozen public files; historical draft wording does not weaken the contract.

mapping.policy.json: tools/solve.py: shared complete event-prefix nodes; supplier_terms and supplier_quotes determine pack units, freight and lead; demand/capacity tables determine current events.
mapping.actor: actor/actor.py: reads public support using explicit raw indices; reconstructs original committed prefix with public packet/replay; compares all consistent support actions. Never selects a future path.
mapping.weekly-ledger.csv: Actual exercise/run-001/journals.json replay using public tree_business.advance; integer minor units. Peaks are BEFORE consumption/dispatch, holding is AFTER fulfilment.
mapping.commitment-policy.csv: Every executed action coordinate including zeros; lot counts (not units), truck supplier ID and empty item, production plant/product IDs.
mapping.receivables.json: Original demand sales prices at absolute due week t+4; week16..19 assets excluded from week15 spendable cash and operating cost.
mapping.summary.json: Exact Fraction-weighted public replay; components keyed purchase_cost/freight_cost/production_cost/holding_cost. Solver floats appear only in explicitly labeled provenance.
mapping.figures: Direct plot of delivered integer weekly ledger and exact component sums; no fabricated illustrative observations.
mapping.exercise: Unmodified public/exercise.py executes this actor; actual commands/PIDs/SQLite exports, commit73/restart, original receipt and row reversal are retained.

preservation: public is read-only; no private sources; no ineffective checksum acceptance. Request-ID digest identifies an idempotency payload, not correctness.
